company.description:
Demeanor.co offers a social application designed for sharing looping videos with friends. The application makes it easy to capture and edit looping videos giving rad photo effects and a community of creatives, enabling users to share their photos with other platforms in just one tap.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, California.
